cards.title: Hydra
cards.description_short: Fast network login brute force tool
cards.description_long: Hydra is a powerful password-cracking tool used to perform brute force attacks against many network services such as SSH, FTP, HTTP, SMB, and more. It supports username lists, password lists, and multiple protocols.

main_commands.explanation: Brute force SSH login using a password list

Analyze logs for brute force attempts

cards.title: John the Ripper
cards.description_long: John the Ripper is a popular password cracking tool used to crack hashed passwords. It supports many hashing algorithms and uses dictionary attacks, brute force, and rule-based attacks.

main_commands.explanation: Use a wordlist for dictionary attack
Prepare Linux password hashes for cracking

Prepare Linux password files for cracking

cards.title: Hashcat
cards.description_long: Hashcat is one of the fastest password recovery tools. It uses GPU acceleration to perform advanced attacks such as dictionary attacks, brute force attacks, mask attacks, and rule-based cracking.

main_commands.explanation: Brute force attack using mask pattern

cards.title: Medusa
cards.description_short: Parallel network login brute force tool
cards.description_long: Medusa is a fast and modular login brute-forcing tool. It supports many services such as SSH, FTP, HTTP, MySQL, and SMB. It allows parallel login attempts to increase cracking speed.

main_commands.explanation: Test multiple usernames and passwords on FTP
Attempt brute force on HTTP login
